from enum import IntEnum

# Represents the type of recognizer an ATN applies to.

class ATNType(IntEnum):

    LEXER = 0
    PARSER = 1

    @classmethod
    def fromOrdinal(cls, i:int):
        return cls._value2member_map_[i]
